title: Wire chat/vtc/scene stream messages into the jmap-websocket extension hook
description: jmap-websocket now has ExtensionHandler (95rh item 2). Plug in: chat-server ChatStreamEnable/Disable around ephemeral::EphemeralSubscription (typing/presence forwarder with 3 s / 30 s rate limits); vtc-server VTCStreamEnable/Disable around VtcEphemeralSubscription (accountId = hosting account; ring/call-end ignore callIds); scene-server SceneStreamEnable/Disable + client SceneInteractionEvent (validate_interaction, relay, no error to sender). CompanionStreams aliases ('vtc','scene' dataTypes) need one combined handler in jmap-chat-vtc-server / jmap-chat-scene-server (union, no duplicates; stream_union tests exist). Scene observe/allowObservers/observerCount from spec 93f2258 goes with JMAP-24aw; close() decrements observerCount. Then register them in jmap-testjig /ws and the toy-websocket-server probe.
